besluite.fout: The pronoun 'dit' can be read as pointing back to 'lug', so the sentence seems to call the air itself space.
besluite.rede: Naming 'daardie plek' fixes the ambiguous pronoun, matches the lesson's own definition of ruimte as a place, and adds no fact.
'Kom wel deur' is natural Afrikaans here; the particle swap only rephrases it, and 'reaches you, but disappears in the bright sky' reads less well with the next clause.
